raw_content:
Here is a Semgrep rule that matches the vulnerable behavior and avoids matching the patched behavior:

```yaml
---
id: "vuln-tabby-1c077147"
title: "Improper Certificate Validation in Tabby SSH Client"
description: "The application uses an outdated version of ssh2-streams library, which does not properly validate the host key. This can lead to man-in-the-middle attacks."
severity: WARNING
language: typescript
file: "**/*.ts"

pattern:
  - '(import * as crypto from \'crypto\';)'
  - '(import * as sshpk from \'sshpk\';)'
  - '(import { Injector, NgZone } from \'@angular/core\';)'
  - '(import { NgbModal } from \'@ng-bootstrap/ng-bootstrap\';)'
  - '(import { ConfigService, FileProvidersService, HostAppService, NotificationsService, Platform, PlatformService, wrapPromise, PromptModalComponent, LogService, Logger, TranslateService } from \'tabby-core\';)'
  - '(import { Client, ClientChannel, SFTPWrapper } from \'ssh2\';)'
  - '(import { Subject, Observable } from \'rxjs\';)'
  - '(import { HostKeyPromptModalComponent } from \'./hostKeyPromptModal.component\';)'
  - '(import { SFTPSession } from \'./sftp\';)'
  - '(import { SSHAlgorithmType, PortForwardType, SSHProfile, SSHProxyStream, AutoPrivateKeyLocator } from \'../api\';)'
  - '(import { supportedAlgorithms } from \'../algorithms\';)'

taint-mode:
  - "crypto"
  - "sshpk"
  - "@angular/core"
  - "@ng-bootstrap/ng-bootstrap"
  - "tabby-core"
  - "ssh2"
  - "rxjs"
  - "./hostKeyPromptModal.component"
  - "./sftp"
  - "../api"
  - "../algorithms"
```

This rule will match any file that imports the specified libraries, which are known to be vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks due to improper certificate validation in the ssh2 library. The taint-mode field is used to specify which import paths should be flagged as potential security issues.
